[[Category:Artificial neural network]]
The '''feedforward algorithm''' is the simplest [[algorithm]] connecting [[artificial neuron#Layer_composition|two layers]] of a multi-layer [[artificial neural network (ANN)]], feeding the output of a layer to the next as input.

== Mathematical formulation ==

[[File:Layer-layer calculation in ANN.png|thumbnail|]]
Let $\vec a^{(l)} \in \mathbb{R}^n$ be the [[artificial neuron#Layer_composition|'''layer activation vector''']] of layer $l$, then the '''input vector''' for the next layer ($l+1$)

$$
\vec x^{(l+1)}=\vec a^{(l)}
$$

=== Basic form ===

In [[artificial neuron#Mathematical_representation|basic form]], where each neuron satisfies

{{#content:Q3075|noNote}}

then with feedforward from layer $l$ ($m$ neurons) to layer $l+1$ ($n$ neurons),

$$
\vec a^{(l+1)} = f(\mathbf{W}\vec a^{(l)} + \vec b)
$$

where $\mathbf{W} \in \mathbb{R}^m \times \mathbb{R}^n$ is the '''weight matrix''', and $\vec b \in \mathbb{R}^m$ the '''bias vector''', both of layer $l+1$, and $f$ is the [[activation function]], often the [[sigmoid function]].

In matrix form:

$$
\vec a^{(l+1)} =
f \left(
\begin{pmatrix}
w_{1,1} & w_{1,2} & \cdots & w_{0,n} \\
w_{2,1} & w_{2,2} & \cdots & w_{1,n} \\
\vdots & \vdots & \ddots & \vdots \\
w_{m,1} & w_{m,2} & \cdots & w_{m,n}
\end{pmatrix}
\begin{pmatrix}
a^{(l)}_1 \\
a^{(l)}_2 \\
\vdots \\
a^{(l)}_n
\end{pmatrix}
+
\begin{pmatrix}
b_1 \\
b_2 \\
\vdots \\
b_m
\end{pmatrix}
\right)
$$

== Implementation ==

=== Python (basic form) ===

<syntaxhighlight lang="python">
def feedforward(self, a):
    """Feedforward input vector a to a_1"""
    for b, w in zip(self.biases, self.weights):
        a_1 = sigmoid(np.dot(w, a) + b)
    return a_1
</syntaxhighlight>
